text:
Nina: Quick sync: scope for private deploy packaging v1. Goals: no k8s agent, clear customer-managed egress modes, offline installer, deterministic upgrade ordering for multi-proxy. Please flag blockers.

Ravi: For egress modes we should document: SOURCE-PASSTHROUGH, SNAT, RELAY, RELAY+PIN. Recommend SNAT as fallback for phase 1.

Zoe: Launch gates: pilot with 2 customers (one IP-preserve), offline installer signed (sha256+gpg), operator smoke tests, rollback playbook, telemetry opt-in.

Marcus: Installer must be single tarball + `install.sh` that validates signature and free disk. Example: `gpg --batch --verify agent.tar.gz.sig agent.tar.gz`.

Nina: Upgrade sequencing: expose `--upgrade-plan` and `upgrade-sequence` in config so NetOps can pin order. Add a dry-run output.

Ravi: KMS note: offline import + local rotate acceptance tests required. No outbound calls during tests.

Zoe: Rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on latency or error regression. Contractually commit to <1h rollback window.

ops-bot: Ticket #5510 created by Marcus: offline-installer-spec (https://git.internal/t/5510)

Nina: Action items: Marcus -> installer spec + demo install.sh; Ravi -> network modes doc; Zoe -> launch checklist & security signoff. Meeting Monday 9am to review.
